title: partnerships
text:
partnerships

mira: Quick heads-up — AcmeHW has confirmed that to be listed in their storefront, devices must report firmware v2.0 metadata. They want a joint announcement with a press embargo on Apr 14 UTC. Need to lock landing page copy + hero asset and decide where the firmware note lives (release notes vs tech spec). Any blockers? :eyes:
sam: Ack. Do we have a compatibility matrix for customers to reference? I can draft a short compat table for the landing page if needed.
alejandra: I can own the landing copy. Request: can product confirm a single short blurb for the hero and a deeper note under "specs"? We should avoid jargon in the hero.
kev: Firmware note should live in specs + a separate FAQ entry. Ops: is the migration path clear for customers on older firmware?
mira: Good call — ops says in-thread 90% of devices can auto-update, ~10% need manual flash. I'll paste the matrix in a sec.
ishan: For press embargo, PMM wants a one-paragraph customer-impact quote from AcmeHW and a short Redwood blurb. PMM can draft Redwood blurb but needs partner quote by Apr 6.
elaine: Legal: make sure partner quote is pre-approved by their comms + we have embargo agreement signed. Also double-check any product claims in the hero re: latency/cost.
sam: Draft compat table snippet (for landing) — can we surface as a small table + a downloadable CSV for SIs?
Mira pasted: ```Device model | FW min | auto-update? 
AX100 | 2.0 | yes 
AX200 | 1.8 -> 2.0 | manual flash required```
alejandra: Nice. I'll turn that into a simplified two-line UI table and add a "see full matrix" link to the CSV.
ishan: Who's owning press timeline? I can coordinate with PMM and Acme comms. Suggest timeline: Apr 6 partner quote + asset signoff, Apr 10 dry run for landing publish + press slot lock, Apr 14 embargo lift. Thoughts?
kev: Add a canary window for the landing publish (limited visibility) on Apr 12 — catch any layout/links issues. Also run the schema check for the firmware metadata field before publish.
elaine: Legal requested we keep a change log entry for any claims around "enterprise-grade" since Acme uses that term. Also require partner to confirm trademark usage.
mira: Action items: 1) Alejandra — draft hero + specs copy by Apr 4. 2) Sam — CSV + small table by Apr 5. 3) Ishan — confirm partner quote + embargo doc by Apr 6. 4) Kev — canary and schema check on Apr 12. 5) Elaine — legal signoff on wording by Apr 9. I'll ping Acme now. :rocket:
launch-bot: Reminder posted: "Embargo task created for 2026-04-14T16:00:00Z — owners: ishan, alejandra, sam"
ishan: Pinged Acme comms, they said quote will be with us by COB Apr 4 if legal review goes smoothly.
alejandra: I'll share first draft here tomorrow AM for quick review. Can someone confirm hero asset orientation? Acme sent both 16:9 and square options.
sam: Use 16:9 for hero, square for partner card in catalog. I'll prepare the CSV and short table tomorrow.
mira: Perfect. If no objections, I'll lock Apr 14 embargo and start the internal calendar invites for dry runs. :+1:
